new_version_available: Update is staged and ready to apply:
update_check_needs_auth: Click ‘Check for updates’ to authorize update check.
update_pending_reboot: Update is ready - reboot to apply.
confirm_rollback_body: Your system will boot into the previous version after a reboot. Continue?
auto_updates_unavailable: Automatic updates are not available on this system
about_details: A simple GUI wrapper around rpm-ostree for checking updates, upgrading, rebooting to apply, rolling back, and rebasing images.
promote_to_stable_confirm_body: This will promote the current image to the stable channel. Continue?
android_intro: Run Android apps in windows on your desktop. Installing downloads about 1.4 GB: Android with Google Play and Google services, and support for ARM apps. Google Play needs this device registered once with your Google account — this tab helps with that after installing.
android_software_rendering: Android cannot use this machine's graphics — an NVIDIA card, or a virtual machine's — and will draw in software, so it will be slow.
android_google_description: Google Play works once this device is registered with your Google account.
android_google_id_hidden: Reading it asks for your password
android_google_not_yet: Start Android once with internet, then try again
android_google_open_page_hint: Paste the ID there, then restart Android and sign in to Play
android_auto_updates_subtitle: Update the Android image daily, never over a metered connection
android_remove_subtitle: Deletes Android, its apps and their data
android_remove_confirm_body: All Android apps and their data will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
android_busy_install: Android is being installed in another window. This page will update when it finishes.
android_busy_upgrade: Android is being updated in the background. This page will update when it finishes.
android_busy_remove: Android is being removed in another window. This page will update when it finishes.
